question: What action is enjoined at the root of the tongue and palate?
premises: The location is the root of the tongue and palate.
Having placed the air there, an action is to be performed.
That action is to drink slowly.
inference: At the root of the tongue and palate, one should place the air and drink it slowly.
uncertainties: The technical sense of drinking air is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
